Name: One Tile High Tree of the Winter Star
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description
[/u]
[list]
[*]Changes collision height of the Tree of the Winter Star so it's smaller
[*]I got the idea from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11781]One Tile High Budget TV[/url]
[*]Mostly this is particularly handy if you're using a CP or AT mod that replaces the tree with something that just doesn't need to be that wide﻿
[/list]


[u]Quick start instructions
[/u]
[list]
[*]Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿﻿)﻿
[*]it's ready to play!
[/list]


[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]Very simple small mod that shouldn't conflict with most mods
[*]mobile compatible
[/list]


[u]Mods this would work well with
[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240]Asters Big Furniture Pack[/url]﻿
[/list]
